NOC (Network Operation Center) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting multiple geographies like NA, India and EU. It ensures hassle free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, NOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem solving NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data.
Overall, NOC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.
Purview Of a Trans Ops Representative
A Trans Ops Representative at NOC facilitates flow of information between different stakeholders (Trans Carriers/Hubs/Warehouses) and resolves any potential issues that impacts customer experience and business continuity. Trans Ops Specialist at NOC works across two verticals – Inbound and Outbound operations.
Inbound Operations deals with Vendor/Carrier/FC relationship, ensuring that the freight is picked-up on time and is delivered at FC as per the given appointment. Trans Ops Specialist on Inbound addresses any potential issues occurring during the lifecycle of pick-up to delivery.
Outbound Operations deals with FC/Carrier/Carrier Hub relationship, ensuring that the truck leaves the FC in order to delivery customer orders as per promise. Trans Ops Specialist on Outbound addresses any potential issues occurring during the lifecycle of freight leaving the FC and reaching customer premises.
A Trans Ops Representative provides timely resolution to the issue in hand by researching and querying internal tools and by taking real-time decisions. An ideal candidate should be able to understand the requirements/be able to analyze data and notice trends and be able to drive Customer Experience without compromising on time. The candidate should have the basic understanding of Logistics and should be able to communicate clearly in the written and oral form.

I. POSITION SUMMARY
Develop a daily production schedule for all assemblies in all production cells and assure adequate resources to meet production, inventory, and customer requirements. Will also be working with the customer base to determine priority of assemblies and order placements within the schedule.
II. NATURE & SCOPE
This position reports directly to the Materials Manager of their facility in Logansport, IN. This position is responsible for coordinating department efforts to ensure that parts are produced on schedule to be used in finished product and/or that finished products are produced so that customer ship dates are met. This process requires the planner to have knowledge of fuel pump components and the assembly line capabilities.
The incumbent is responsible for using the MRP system to generate shop orders for the work centers assigned. All associated documents (i.e. labels, etc.) along with the shop orders are to be released daily to the manufacturing floor.
The Master Scheduler is to communicate shortages of materials and capacity to the appropriate personnel daily. The shortages impacting the release of a shop order that may affect our ability to meet a customer demand are communicated during a daily production meeting and/or to the Operations Team.
The Master Scheduler communicates priorities to each supervisor in a daily production meeting. The incumbent may release materials from vendors to meet the production schedule and to maintain desired stocking levels. In the case of an unforeseen demand, the incumbent may expedite the appropriate material to ensure on-time delivery to the customer. They may also communicate shortages to the Buyers in the event of purchased material shortages. This communication is essential to maintain good customer service and appropriate inventory levels.
The major challenge of this position is managing hundreds of part numbers on a daily basis to meet customer ship dates and to maintain appropriate inventory levels. Coordinating the daily schedules and communicating the priorities throughout the plant is a very important part to maintaining the plant objectives as defined by our SQCD process.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Content Writer/Editor (Financial Services)Client Location: Hybrid, Chicago IL.Salary/Pay Rate: $55 - $60/Hourly (W2)Hours: Full-timeDuration: Approx. 6 Months
Job Description:We're looking for a talented contract writer/editor to support our trading articles team on our website. We educate self-directed traders and investors at all stages of the learning curve—beginner to advanced—in multiple markets and asset classes. We write for information-hungry people of all backgrounds who want more than the typical “daily roundup” coverage. Most importantly, we want our current and prospective clients to learn how to build a financial future hands-on with some of the best tools and educational content in the industry.
Candidates must already have:A minimum of 7 to 10 years in markets/business journalism experience. Your published work samples will show you’ve written regularly about market events, trading/investing strategies and a range of asset classes with an easy, inviting style that can be understood by any reader.News savvy. You pay daily attention to corporate, economic, geopolitical, social and consumer trends that can move markets. You read widely, build source relationships easily and continually bookmark ideas to fuel new articles and keep existing high-performing content current.An interest in personal finance. You see the rich story territory between trading/investing education and how those readers can better meet their financial goals. Our new and prospective clients want to build trading and investment expertise, but they also pay taxes, send kids to college and hope for a successful retirement like anyone else. In this role, you'll be handling such money topics through a trader's eyes.Remote team skills. You understand remote work, self-publishing technology and what it's like to work with teammates working from anywhere. This position is based in Chicago, but the articles team is located around the country. We read each other's work before publication and every piece of content we produce goes through a rigorous subject matter expert and compliance approval process that takes time and attention—all by phone and email.
You’ll be producing:Definitive, timely content for traders and investors. You'll join a markets-focused team that delivers both breaking coverage and fresh, topical content that explains what's trading and how to trade it…
